Subject: MaAsLin

Dear Nicole,

I have a very quick doubt about a parameter description in MaAsLin: in "Minimum for feature prevalence filtering The minimum percentage of samples a feature can have abudance in before being removed." does the default value "0.01" really mean 0.01% or is it in fact 1% (0.01)?

I tried using the MaAsLin contact email (tti...@hsph.harvard.edu) but it doesn't work any longer. I also tried emailing Dr. Huttenhower directly, but got no reply. Would you be able to help me??

Thanks a lot. Best regards.

Paolo De Marco
Prof. Auxiliar
IUCS, CESPU
Gandra Paredes

Portugal

messages.subject: Re: MaAsLin
messages.body_plain:
Hi Paolo,

It’s a combination of prevalence and abundance filtering - in particular, MaAsLin retains features with >0.01% relative abundance in at least 10% of the samples by default. Of course, you can tweak these parameters according to your need. Let me know if that answers your question.

Many thanks,
Himel
